description: Price a whole shopping list or RFQ in one call: many line items, each with its own quantity, for office and IT supplies and instant event print (name cards, lanyards, roll-up banners, tote bags). Returns per line the match level (exact, spec, similar, needs_detail or no_match), the all-in SGD price (9% GST and Singapore delivery included) and the ready-by date, plus a total for priced lines and a list of what to clarify with the buyer. Pass lines as strings ('3 x HDMI cable 5m') or objects with item, quantity, category, brand, model, specs. Unpriced lines carry no price: the clarify list names what is missing for each, and request_quote accepts the returned list_id for a firm quote. Example input: {"items":["3 x HDMI cable 5m","microSD 128GB x10"]}.

buyer_email.description: Optional: buyer email, used if the list is converted to a firm quote.

delivery_area.description: Delivery address or area in Singapore (prices already include Singapore delivery).

anyOf.description: One line in the buyer's words, quantity included, e.g. '3 x HDMI cable 5m', 'microSD 128GB x10', '2 pcs HP 206A cyan toner'.

category.description: Optional: a supplies category (cable, adapter, usb-hub, memory-card, flash-drive, ssd, hdd, card-reader, ...) or an event print category (name-cards, lanyards, roll-up-banners, tote-bags).

item.description: The buyer's own wording for this line.

model.description: Model number or cartridge code exactly as printed.

quantity.description: How many units of this line item the buyer needs.

specs.description: Technical details that pin down the exact product, such as connector types, cable length, storage capacity or screen size. Uses the same fields as quote_office_supplies specs: connectors, length, capacity, card_type, va_rating, colour, ports, screen_size, wireless, interface.

needed_by.description: Deadline for the whole list, YYYY-MM-DD, Singapore time.

text.description: Alternative to items: a pasted free-text list, one item per line (quantities like '3 x', 'x3', '3 pcs' are recognised).

name: quote_list
title: Price a list of items (RFQ)
